bio.text: Jennifer Day, a Democrat, is a candidate for Kansas Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Day was appointed to a vacancy in the Kansas House in 2020, won election to the seat by 62 votes, and resigned in 2021 after moving out of the district.
Day has lived in Overland Park for 25 years and has served as vice president of the Johnson County chapter of the League of Women Voters.

sources.title: Who's running for Kansas secretary of state in 2026? Here's a guide
